subs.note: Dominique Phinot. The movements of the mass, each on its own.

items.title: Kyrie (Phinot, Missa Si bona suscepimus)
items.desc: Dominique Phinot, Missa Si bona suscepimus, Kyrie, 1557. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
